messages:
Maria: Quick sync — vendor timeline + buyer-facing guidance doc. We need to reconcile H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi slots for Q3/Q4. Can we get alignment by EOD Thurs? :eyes:
Kevin: From eng side, H100 infra looks good for Sept wave but H200 drivers still TBD from vendor. Need test images by 9/10.
Alex: Product asks: marketplace listing freeze dates? We can't accept new SKUs after 10/15 if we want October launch.
Nina: Marketing wants embargo windows. Prefer joint announce week of 10/23. Will need firm hands-off by 10/9 for assets.
Samir: SI integrations — big risk is kernel mismatch for MI300. Proposed mitigation: pre-cert lane with partner labs, 2-week soak.
Maria: Proposed action items: 1) vendor commit matrix, 2) marketplace freeze date, 3) SI pre-cert plan. I'll draft and share.
Kevin: Will follow up with infra timeline + test harness. Need access to vendor QA images — @nvidia @amd can you confirm delivery cadence?
deploy-bot: Reminder: weekly vendor sync scheduled Tue 15:00 PT. Next: 2471170000 -> https://calendar.example.com/evt/2471170000
Alex: If vendors can't commit, fallback: H100 + Gaudi 1st wave, MI300 as canary with reduced SLA. Thoughts?
Nina: Agreed on staggered announce. Marketing can craft "Early Access" messaging for MI300 canary.
Maria: Draft matrix attached (internal):
```
- H100: ga -> Sept / vendor images by 2028-09-10
- H200: tentative -> Nov / vendor driver TBD
- B200: available / already in marketplace
- MI300: pre-cert -> Oct canary (2-week soak)
- Gaudi: Oct general
```
Kevin: Small ask — can we get kernel patch notes in PR form? makes triage easier.
Samir: I'll open staging tickets for SI partners and tag SIs. Also prepping KMS/HSM checklist for Private deployments.
Maria: OK let's aim to close vendor commits by Fri EOD. I'll ping vendors and share buyer guide outline tomorrow. :thumbsup:
